title: Level 1 Problem 1
problemStatement: Scenario Y is A with probability 0.49 and B otherwise. E[X|A]=14 and E[X|B]=9. Find E[X].
hint1: Identify Y as the scenario variable.
hint2: Compute E[X|Y=A] and E[X|Y=B], then weight by P(Y).

solutionSteps.title: Step 1
solutionSteps.text: Use total expectation with Y in {A,B}.

simulationCheck: Sample Y then return 14 or 9 conditionally.

title: Level 4 Problem 1
problemStatement: Y is local/mall with P(mall)=0.4. Coupon Z has P(Z=1|local)=0.12 and P(Z=1|mall)=0.33. E[X|Y,Z]=32+11*1_{Y=mall}-5.5 Z. Find E[X].
hint1: First compute E[X|Y] by averaging over Z.
hint2: Then average E[X|Y] over Y (tower property).
simulationCheck: Sample Y, sample Z|Y, evaluate X from conditional mean model.
